svg.aria-label: NetStore — Who bought what, who owes what, what runs out. Stock, sales, customers, debt and collections for a retail shop: a dashboard of investment, sales, profit and low stock, invoices that print, dark and light themes, Dari with Persian numerals — and it keeps working offline.
